data.long_meaning: Balf is an Old English name, derived from the Old English word 'bealf'. It means 'strong, powerful, warrior'. The name was popular during the Anglo-Saxon period and was often given to boys destined for great things. The name Balf carries the meaning “Strong, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balf usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
